user.title: Connect your AppLights Star Spinner
user.description: Keep AppLights closed. Choose Star SpinnerC / BTM2-5 and enter its current password, or select the factory default and leave the password field blank. Factory default does not reset the light. Optionally request a new password on the next screen.

data.change_password: Set a new password after connecting

password.title: Connect {name}
password.description: Enter the current password, or choose the documented factory default 000000 and leave the password field blank. This only tries that password; it does not reset the light. Keep AppLights closed. Select the optional change below to choose a new password on the next screen.

data.change_password: Set a new password after connecting

new_password.title: Set a new light password
new_password.description: Enter and confirm a new password (1–8 UTF-8 bytes; up to 8 plain ASCII characters). Submit changes this light's password. Keep a copy until verification finishes. Home Assistant will disconnect and verify a fresh login before saving it. Keep the AppLights phone app closed. The light's output is not changed.

recover_password.title: Verify the password change
recover_password.description: The change may have reached the light, but its current password could not be verified. Submit retries login with the proposed password, then the previous password only if the proposed one is rejected. It does not send another password change. Close AppLights and check power/range. If you cancel or Home Assistant restarts, remember both passwords: use setup or 'Update saved password' with the new one first, then the previous one if rejected.

error.not_supported: This light does not identify as the supported Star SpinnerC / BTM2-5.
error.cannot_connect: Could not complete the connection. Close AppLights, check power and Bluetooth range, then try again.
error.password_mismatch: The two new passwords must match.
error.same_password: Choose a password different from the current password.
error.change_rejected: The light rejected the password change. Home Assistant retained the previous password.
error.change_not_applied: The new password was rejected and the previous password still works. No replacement was saved. You may explicitly try a change again.
error.verification_pending: Could not verify the current password. Check power and range, then retry verification. No additional change was sent.

abort.not_supported: Only Star SpinnerC / BTM2-5 has been validated.

change_password.title: Change the light's password
change_password.description: Home Assistant will authenticate with its saved current password. Enter and confirm a new password (1–8 UTF-8 bytes; up to 8 plain ASCII characters). Submit changes this light's password. Keep a copy until verification finishes. Home Assistant will disconnect and verify a fresh login before saving it. Keep the AppLights phone app closed. The light's output is not changed.

update_password.title: Update Home Assistant's saved password
update_password.description: Use this after changing the password in AppLights, resetting the light, or recovering from an interrupted change. This verifies a login and updates Home Assistant only; it does not change the light's password. For factory default, select the checkbox and leave the field blank.

recover_password.title: Verify the password change
recover_password.description: The change may have reached the light, but its current password could not be verified. Submit retries login with the proposed password, then the previous password only if the proposed one is rejected. It does not send another password change. Close AppLights and check power/range. If you cancel or Home Assistant restarts, remember both passwords: use setup or 'Update saved password' with the new one first, then the previous one if rejected.
